BETA Close X RS Group PLC has purchased 1,273,481 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. These purchases occurred between June 15 and June 19, 2026, with prices ranging from 612.0000 pence to 641.5000 pence per share. Following these transactions, the company will have 472,775,987 ordinary shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury, resulting in a total of 472,775,987 voting rights. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 22 June 2026 RS Group plc 22 June 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 15 June 2026 to 19 June 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 472,775,987 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury.
